strategy_roster.name: AnyRange Cloud Tail System Tm Plus
strategy_roster.notes: The 02:00-07:00 intraday range cannot be isolated without time fields, so a 20-bar Donchian stands in for the stored range; the documented SignalBar=1 delay is kept by requiring the signal bar to close back inside the band. StopLossPoints/TakeProfitPoints and the 1500-minute time exit are price-step/time fields, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: SMC Strategy BTC 1H OB FVG
strategy_roster.entry_long: bars_since(close > donchian_high_prev(high,20)) < 10 and close < donchian_high(high,20) and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish break of structure is a close above the prior 20-bar high and the entry is a pullback into that broken zone within the documented ZoneTimeout of 10 bars while price holds above EMA(20). Order-block and fair-value-gap construction and the ATR(6x) stop with a 2.5 risk/reward target are not expressible as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: EMA RSI Swing Trend Filter
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,20), ema(close,50)) and close > ema(close,200) and rsi(close,14) < 70
strategy_roster.notes: All documented lengths are used (EMA 20/50/200, RSI 14) with RsiMaxLong=70 blocking overbought longs, and ExitOnOpposite supplies the mirror cross. The 5-minute timeframe and the short side are outside this long-only roster; stops are documented as absent.

strategy_roster.name: Hedging Martingale
strategy_roster.notes: The EA opens a simultaneous long and short leg on every new bar and only averages after adverse pip moves, so it contains no market-derived directional signal; the impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating one. Money/percent basket targets, trailing lock, per-leg take profit and trade caps are portfolio overlays.

strategy_roster.name: Two Pending Orders 2
strategy_roster.notes: This is a pending-order placement utility that brackets the market with symmetric stops on every evaluation and never derives a direction from price, so no signal is invented. Stop/target/trailing distances in price steps, MaxPositions, spread filter and expiry minutes are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: BB Breakout Momentum Squeeze
strategy_roster.notes: The squeeze-off state is Bollinger(20,2) bands outside an EMA(20)+-2*ATR(10) Keltner proxy and the bull oscillator is a z-score(14) crossing its midline, matching the documented Threshold 50. The ATR(30) x1.4 stop and the 1.5 risk-reward target are ATR-based, not percentage, fields.

strategy_roster.name: Prop Firm Business Simulator
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner channels are rebuilt as EMA(20) +- 2*ATR(10) using the documented MaPeriod, AtrPeriod and Multiplier, so a close outside the band is the entry and the opposite band the exit. The band-distance stop and RiskPerTrade position sizing are account-level, not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: N Candles v6
strategy_roster.notes: bars_since counts the streak of identical candles, so no down bar within the last three bars is the documented CandlesCount=3 of consecutive bullish candles. TakeProfitPips/StopLossPips/TrailingStopPips, the 11-18 session window and MaxPositionVolume are pip, time and sizing fields.

strategy_roster.name: Reversing Martingale
strategy_roster.notes: The documentation states the strategy uses no indicators or market structure and simply alternates direction after each closed deal, so there is no deterministic market-derived signal to translate. The lot multiplier cycle and symmetric point-based stop/target are position-management fields.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: %K is rebuilt as the classic fast stochastic over a 14-bar window (the document gives no period) with the documented default level of 50 for both directions; the small epsilon guards a zero-width range.
